operator: Maintainer-operated agent; not external human first use
persona: Anonymous public visitor in isolated browser context

matrix.data: Actual live public page content. No synthetic answers, contact details or result links.

G0: Click real Labs readiness card; assert intended URL and introduction heading; public anonymous persona only; source inbound link inspection
G1: Direct navigation and reload of readiness introduction; document outcome and console exceptions; browser Back/Forward between real entry and readiness
G2: Observe entry-to-introduction resolution and local intro-to-first-question-to-help-to-return transitions; ensure no selected answer and disabled Next
G3: View actual 1280x800 dark-theme screenshots for chosen states; inspect geometry and reduced-motion context; SSR-only intro visibility
G4: Inspect affected headings, question, help and Back copy; scan visible text for raw failure tokens and duplicate IDs
G5: Live semantics and meaningful names; question heading focus; Tab/Space disclosure behavior and visible focus; Back focus restoration; measure actual risky primary-button text/background contrast
G6: Challenge real entry vs deeplink substitution; repeat first-question transition after history/reload; verify that blocked event POST is instrumentation and does not masquerade as clean console; challenge scope exclusions

instrumentation_scope: Live semantic/keyboard/focus and measured primary-button contrast. No instrumented accessibility conformance audit is required by this explicit limited interaction review; no accessibility conformance claim will be made.

excluded_checks.GP: Performance budgets and metrics are outside the requested entry/state acceptance. No performance change or speed claim is under review.
excluded_checks.result and quiz answers: User expressly limited this review to read-only navigation and initial states; no answers or form results are submitted.
excluded_checks.other viewports/themes/locales: The requested demonstration is this existing desktop English path, not responsive or localization acceptance.
excluded_checks.other persona/account contexts: The path has no login or account context; the anonymous visitor is its sole applicable persona.

policy: Block all non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests; no application source modifications or publication.
